THE LAW OF SINESTLE
Trigonometric principles can be used to solve triangles which are not right triangles.
DISCUSSION
A triangle which does not have a right angle is called an oblique triangle.
The relationships between the sides and angles of a triangle are used to solve for the missing parts of a triangle.
The first relationship we will discuss is called the law of sines.
The law of sines comes from dividing the oblique triangle into two right triangles and applying the sine function.
